technical_overview: Offered at $28.0 for 3.5g, this KoColor LIPSTICK is expertly formulated with Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Carnauba Wax, Dimethicone, Iron Oxides, Red 33 Lake. Delivering a high-fidelity Midnight Crimson color profile (`#541624`), it leverages advanced engineering via high-purity pigments and volatile carriers. For optimal chromatic impact, apply directly to a clean, prepped surface.
